clips.title: Twitch chat clips
clips.description: Create clips from Twitch chat commands and send their links to Discord. These settings are separate from stream notifications.
clips.botDescription: The operator connects the Twitch bot account once. Tokens are stored securely in the backend. Streamers do not need to authorize the bot.
clips.connectedSuccess: The Twitch bot account is connected.
clips.oauthError: Twitch authorization failed or expired. Please connect again.
clips.disconnected: The Twitch bot account is not connected.
clips.chatDisconnected: The chat connection is currently offline.
clips.jobsDisabled: Background jobs are disabled. Chat commands cannot create clips until they are enabled.
clips.runtimeError: The chat connection reported an issue ({code}). Ask the operator to check the integration.
clips.notConfigured: The operator must configure the Twitch client, redirect URL, encryption key and bot username first.
clips.operatorHelp: Only the dashboard operator can connect or disconnect the shared bot account. Ask them for help if it is offline.
clips.failed: Could not update Twitch clip settings.
clips.aliasesHelp: Separate aliases with commas, for example !c, !moment.
clips.empty: No Twitch chat clip channels configured yet.
clips.invalid: Enter a Twitch username, Discord destination and command. Cooldown must be 15–3600 seconds and duration 5–60 seconds.
clips.channelLimit: The shared bot has reached its limit of 100 Twitch channels. Ask the operator to remove unused channels.
clips.botUnavailable: The bot account connection is unavailable. Ask the operator to reconnect it.
clips.authorizationRevoked: Twitch revoked chat authorization. Ask the operator to reconnect the bot account.
clips.subscriptionFailed: Some Twitch channels could not be subscribed. The bot will retry automatically.
clips.connectionFailed: The Twitch chat connection failed. The bot will retry automatically.
clips.eventFailed: A Twitch chat event could not be processed. Ask the operator to check the integration.
